picks.thesis: bayesian_breakout: ETH consolidating above 2550 structural support with declining on-chain outflows and rising spot delta; prior trend is bullish and new evidence (volume compression, funding rate reset) updates continuation probability above 65%. Expect volatility expansion to the upside within 14d.

bayesian_breakout: AVAX breaking above descending resistance trendline with increasing OBV and positive exchange reserve drawdown; prior breakout attempts on lower timeframe increase Bayesian likelihood of follow-through. Substrate narrative and subnet adoption catalysts reinforce directional edge.

bayesian_breakout: UNI failing at overhead supply zone near $12 with bearish divergence on RSI and rising OI suggesting leveraged long crowding; prior rejection at same zone in prior cycle updates posterior probability of mean reversion downward. DeFi TVL stagnation weakens fundamental backdrop.

bayesian_breakout: ARB exhibiting volatility compression (Bollinger bandwidth at multi-week low) with declining open interest, historically a precursor to directional expansion; prior similar setups on L2 tokens resulted in >15% moves. L2 fee revenue growth provides fundamental tailwind.

Cross-sectional momentum leader: ADBE dominates the software sector with strongest relative strength, driven by AI-powered creative suite adoption and enterprise FCF expansion. Outperforming sector peers on both price and earnings momentum.

Strong upward momentum from AI agent integration driving net-new enterprise pipeline. CRM showing relative strength vs. SaaS peers with accelerating revenue revisions and improving seat-based growth metrics.

Sector momentum rotation into financials amid stable-to-rising rate expectations. JPM leading bank cohort with strongest earnings momentum, expanding margin trajectory, and positive fund-flow positioning.

Weakest relative momentum in the payments sub-sector. PYPL underperforming V and sector index, facing competitive pressure from Apple Pay and BNPL, with deteriorating merchant volume growth and negative fund-flow signals.

Multi-timeframe trend alignment: 20/50/200 EMA positive slope convergence on daily, ADX crossing above 40 on weekly with volatility regime expansion confirming breakout continuation from consolidation structure
Volatility-adjusted momentum score below -1.5σ with descending 20/50/200 MA alignment across daily and weekly timeframes; regime filter confirms bearish structure with expanding downside volatility

ADX above 40 on both daily and weekly confirming strong trend, volatility regime expansion with Bollinger squeeze breakout; 20/50/200 MA convergence with positive slope alignment across three timeframes signals systematic trend entry

inventory_cycle: Summer gasoline demand peak approaching; EIA crude and gasoline inventories trending below 5-year average with persistent draws. OPEC+ production discipline tightens supply. Positioning for a post-EIA report upside breakout if draw confirms seasonal deficit pattern.

inventory_cycle: EIA storage injection rates running below 5-year average as summer cooling demand ramps up. Below-normal storage builds signal tightening supply balance into peak consumption months. Beat-and-raise injection data would catalyze upside.

inventory_cycle: LME registered copper inventories in sustained decline; China stimulus-driven infrastructure demand and accelerating EV/renewable buildout underpin structural deficit. EIA industrial metals data and warehouse warrant conversions support near-term upside.

inventory_cycle: COMEX silver registered stocks recovering after earlier drawdowns; speculative long positioning crowded. Industrial demand tied to manufacturing PMI showing softening signals. Inventory replenishment cycle argues for mean-reversion lower on any demand-side disappointment.

EURUSD trades ~2.5% below OECD PPP fair value of ~1.12. EUR undervaluation relative to PPP equilibrium creates mean-reversion upside bias as real rate differentials compress and trade flows rebalance over 21d horizon.

USDJPY at 142.5 is ~20% above PPP equilibrium (~118). Extreme deviation from PPP fair value historically resolves with JPY strengthening. BOJ policy normalization and carry unwind support mean reversion over 21d.

GBPUSD trades ~12% below PPP fair value of ~1.42. GBP persistent undervaluation on PPP basis, combined with UK inflation converging toward US, creates reversion setup. Risk-on flow recovery catalyzes move over 21d.

USDCHF at 0.808 sits ~3% above PPP fair value of ~0.78. Swiss trade-weighted franc undervaluation is narrowing. SNB credibility anchor and US dollar mean reversion favor CHF appreciation over 21d window.

SOL breaking above descending wedge with rising volume and strong relative strength vs BTC. On-chain metrics show increasing active addresses and DEX volume surge. Accumulation pattern suggests continuation of uptrend with 14d target near resistance zone.

XRP failing to sustain above $3 with declining volume on recent bounces. Distribution pattern evident on CEX order books with rising sell-side pressure. Broader altcoin rotation favors capital rotation into higher-beta plays.

LINK outperforming mid-cap peers with CCIP cross-chain adoption accelerating and new oracle integrations. Token unlock schedule favorable in near-term with decreasing circulating supply pressure. Bullish divergence on RSI supports continuation.

AI infrastructure demand remains secular and accelerating; NVDA consolidating near key moving averages after minor profit-taking pullback, Blackwell ramp providing multi-quarter revenue upside catalyst, institutional flow supportive with options skew favoring calls

Net interest margin compression accelerating as deposit repricing lags rate cuts, credit card loan delinquency rates elevated signaling consumer stress, technical breakdown below 200-day MA with declining institutional ownership, sector rotation into tech reducing relative inflows
Gold holding above key 2350 support with central bank buying and geopolitical risk premium intact; declining real yields and de-dollarization flows favor continued upside
Rocket Lab showing higher-lows accumulation pattern on daily chart with volume increasing on up-days; space/defense sector tailwinds and upcoming launch catalysts provide near-term upside edge
SQQQ benefiting from short-term volatility spike and overbought RSI on QQQ daily chart; divergence between QQQ price and breadth indicators suggests mean-reversion pullback within the week
CleanSpark extended above key resistance on hype-driven volume with declining OBV; Bitcoin miner margins compressed and elevated debt create downside vulnerability on any BTC consolidation
